div.head: VIII Atr 20.1
div.ab: And gif man hine tihtlige þryfealdre spræce, nime six his gehadan ⁊ ladige mid þam ⁊ beo he silf seofoða.
And gif man hine tihtlige þryfealdre spræce, nime six his gehádan ⁊ ladige mid þam ⁊ beo he silf seofoða.
And gif man hine tihtlige þryfealdre spræce, nime six his gehadan and ladige mid þam and beo he silf seofoða.
Und wenn er mit dreifacher Anklage bezichtigt wird, so nehme er sechs seiner Standesgenossen und reinige sich mit denen und er selbst sei der siebente [im Eide].
And if he is charged with a threefold accusation, let him take six of his fellow-clergy and clear himself with them, and be himself the seventh [in the oath].
And if a triple accusation is brought against him, he shall take six supporters of the same ecclesiastical rank—himself making a seventh—and clear himself with their help.
And if he is charged with a three-fold accusation, he is to take six supporters in the same orders and clear himself with them, and he himself is to be the seventh.
And if a threefold accusation is brought against him, he is to take six clerics of his rank and, himself being the seventh, exculpate himself with them.
